brief.zh: 在补电网页里选一个起始电量，发送给服务器。看看数字怎样回到你眼前的网页。
brief.en: Choose a starting charge on the charging page and send it to the server. See how the answer gets back to your page.

concept.zh: 浏览器发请求，服务器算结果
concept.en: The browser asks and the server calculates

rule.en: Add 3 units to the starting charge

caption.zh: 你点了发送，浏览器把选中的 6 放进请求，送到服务器。
caption.en: When you click Send, the browser puts your chosen number, 6, in a request to the server.

caption.zh: 服务器收到请求，让补电程序用 6 来计算。补电程序按规则加 3。
caption.en: The server receives the request and runs the charging program with 6. The program adds 3.

caption.zh: 服务器把算出的 9 放进响应，发回给刚才的浏览器。
caption.en: The server puts the result, 9, in a response to the browser.

caption.zh: 浏览器收到响应，从里面读到 9，把它显示在你打开的网页上。
caption.en: The browser receives the response, reads the 9 and shows it on the page you opened.

title.zh: 浏览器负责发出输入和显示结果
title.en: The browser sends input and shows the result

body.zh: 浏览器打开网页，记住你选的起始电量。点击发送时，它把数字放进一条请求，向服务器要结果。收到回信后，浏览器把结果放进网页。
body.en: The browser opens the page and remembers the charge you choose. When you click Send, it puts that number in a request asking the server for an answer. When the reply arrives, the browser puts the answer on the page.

title.zh: 服务器负责计算并回信

body.zh: 服务器是接收请求并回信的一方。这个例子里，它拿到请求里的数字，让补电程序加 3，再把结果放进回信。服务器发回的这条回信叫响应。
body.en: The server receives the request and replies. Here it takes the number from the request, runs the charging program to add 3 and sends back the result. The server's reply is called a response.

prompt.zh: 这次你要从网页给芽芽补电，选了 1 格。哪条路线会把结果 4 显示到你眼前？
prompt.en: This time you choose 1 unit on the web page. Which route gets the result, 4, onto your screen?

options.zh: 浏览器发出 1，服务器算出 4 并回信，浏览器显示 4。
options.en: The browser sends 1, the server works out 4 and replies, and the browser shows 4.

options.zh: 服务器发出 1，浏览器算出 4 并回信，服务器显示 4。
options.en: The server sends 1, the browser works out 4 and replies, and the server shows 4.

options.zh: 浏览器发出 1，服务器把 1 送回，浏览器显示 1。
options.en: The browser sends 1, the server sends back 1, and the browser shows 1.

feedback.zh: 浏览器把你的输入交给服务器，服务器算出结果，再由浏览器显示。试试发送 1 格，沿着回放找出数字从 1 变成 4 的那一步。
feedback.en: The browser passes your input to the server. The server calculates the result, and the browser displays it. Send 1 unit and follow the replay to see where it changes to 4.
